address: Pen Y Lan, Fox Street, Ardleigh, Colchester, CO7 7PN
description: An extension to an existing garage building in the rear garden of a property near Colchester.

caseStudy.heading: The Brief
caseStudy.text: Mr Mitchell wanted to extend the existing garage building in the rear garden at Pen Y Lan, Fox Street, Ardleigh, near Colchester.

caseStudy.heading: The Approach
caseStudy.text: Architecture ONE designed an extension to the existing garage building, prepared to the Local Planning Authority's site location, block plan and elevation requirements.

caseStudy.heading: The Outcome
caseStudy.text: Tendring District Council granted full planning permission for the garage extension in November 2018 (application ref. 18/01546/FUL).
